title: pp.twisted-delays2-st~
description: `pp.twisted-delays2-st~` is the stereo version of `pp.twisted-delays2~`, implementing a complex delay network with controllable delay times, rotation angles, feedback, damping, modulation, and dry/wet balance. Its first two creation arguments are required and specify the number of delay instances and the maximum delay time; an optional third argument sets the internal block size and thus the minimum delay time in samples.
